Old Galician-Portuguese

[edit]
A user has added this entry to requests for verification(+)
If it cannot be verified that this term meets our attestation criteria, it will be deleted. Feel free to edit this entry as normal, but do not remove {{rfv}} until the request has been resolved.

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • gengivre, gingivre, gingibre (15th c.)

Etymology

[edit]

Either from Old Spanish gengibre or directly from the latter's source- Old Occitan gengibre. First attested in the 13th century.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /d͡ʒenˈd͡ʒibɾe/

Noun

[edit]

gengibre m (plural gengibres)

  1. ginger

Descendants

[edit]
  • Galician: xenxibre, xenxebre, sinxebra, gengibre (reintegrationist)
  • Portuguese: gengibre

References

[edit]
  • “gengibre”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • Da Cunha, Antônio Geraldo (2012), “gengibre”, in Dicionário etimológico da língua portuguesa, Rio de Janeiro: Lexicon

Old Spanish

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • gengivre

Etymology

[edit]

    Borrowed from Old Occitan gengibre.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ʒenˈʒibɾe/

    Noun

    [edit]

    gengibre m (plural gengibres)

    1. ginger

    Descendants

    [edit]
    • Spanish: jengibre
      • → Basque: jengibre
    • → Old Galician-Portuguese: gengibre, gengivre, gingivre, gingibre (15th c.)
      • Galician: xenxibre, xenxebre, sinxebra, gengibre (reintegrationist)
      • Portuguese: gengibre
    • → Old Leonese:
      • Asturian: xenxibre

    References

    [edit]
    • Coromines, Joan; Pascual, José Antonio (1984), “jengibre”, in Diccionario crítico etimológico castellano e hispánico [Critical Castilian and Hispanic etymological dictionary]‎[1] (in Spanish), volume III (G–Ma), Madrid: Gredos, →ISBN, page 506

    Portuguese

    [edit]
    Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
    gengibre
    Wikipedia pt

    Etymology

    [edit]

    Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese gengibre, either from Old Spanish gengibre or directly from the latter’s source: Old Occitan gengibre, from Late Latin gingiber, from Latin zingiberī. Compare Galician xenxibre.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
     
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʒẽˈʒi.bɾi/
    • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ʒẽˈʒi.bɾi/
      • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ʒẽˈʒi.bɾe/
    • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ʒẽˈʒi.bɾɨ/ [ʒẽˈʒi.βɾɨ]

    • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
    • Hyphenation: gen‧gi‧bre

    Noun

    [edit]

    gengibre m (plural gengibres)

    1. ginger

    Further reading

    [edit]
    • “gengibre”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026
